basic_info.description: 30 Lloyd is a Gorgeous Top Floor condo in a gracious four-unit Edwardian building. Tucked away on a quiet one block street and just steps from Duboce Park, you cannot beat this location! Period details throughout include wainscoting, built-ins, soaring ceilings, picture rails and bay windows. This home gets so much light and the bright and inviting living room has views of the Downtown skyline! The lovely outlooks extend to the recently refreshed kitchen and the laundry room with side by side washer/dryer. An extra deeded ground floor finished room can be used in various creative ways!  Sweet shared backyard.  Walk to EVERYTHING including the N-Judah, shops on Haight Street, cafes, restaurants, the Castro, and more. The Duboce Triangle neighborhood is a coveted and thriving San Francisco community in the center of San Francisco. Welcome home!
